entities.name: Mesylate SN2 alkylation
observations: An alkyl mesylate bearing a 3-carbon tether to a chlorinated bicyclic lactam/benzimidazolone-like nitrogen is plausibly displaced by the secondary amine in the second reactant.
The aryl C–Cl bond is retained; the transformation is N-alkylation rather than aryl SNAr, deprotection, cross-coupling, or salt formation.

entities.name: Propyl piperidine N-alkylation
observations: The expected product has the second-reactant secondary piperidine nitrogen bonded to the terminal carbon of the former 3-mesyloxypropyl chain; mesylate leaves as methanesulfonate.

entities.name: Chlorinated propyl mesylate scaffold
observations: The first reactant is assigned as a 3-(mesyloxy)propyl-substituted chlorinated bicyclic lactam/benzimidazolone-like scaffold.
The propyl chain remains attached to the heterocyclic nitrogen in the product.

entities.name: Secondary cyclic amine partner
observations: The second reactant contains a secondary piperidine-like nitrogen that acts as the nucleophile in the proposed SN2 reaction.
Its other urea-containing bicyclic functionality is retained in the product.
